missed.maker: Texas Instruments (data sheet SNAS809C; JLCPCB label 'Texas Instruments', jlcparts maker field blank); S1 Texas Instruments
missed.why: A family P2 did not consider (REF35), for the reference option. It meets every requirement value that P2's shortlisted REF3330 fails or only just meets. Data sheet REF35 SNAS809C (Rev. C, September 2024; first revision December 2021), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ref35.pdf, read 2026-09-29T03:08:39Z. Table 6.5 figures apply over -40 to 125 degC unless noted. (1) Supply from the board rails: VIN min is VREF + VDO (6.3 and 6.5). VDO max is 120 mV at IL 5 mA and 250 mV at 10 mA, over temperature. That is a stated loaded limit above the 0.53 mA load. The worst-case output is 3.0068 V, so VIN min is 3.127 V. The 3.3 V rail's low end of 3.201 V leaves 74 mV of margin. VIN max is 6 V, above 3.399 V. For comparison, the REF3330 states VIN min VOUT + 0.2 V (SBOS392I, read 03:11:01Z), and the REF3330 misses it. (2) ADC_AVDD voltage from the reference: accuracy is +/-0.05 % at 25 degC. Drift is 12 ppm/degC by the box method over -40 to 105 degC, a 5.22 mV box. Line regulation is 120 ppm/V max: 0.11 mV from the 3.5 V test condition down to 3.201 V. Load regulation is 60 ppm/mA: 0.10 mV at 0.53 mA. That gives 2.993 V to 3.007 V, inside 2.97 to 3.201 V. The REF3330 gives 2.983 V. Hysteresis is 70 ppm typical (0.21 mV), and that is typical, not a limit. (3) Reference output current: IL -5 to +10 mA. The output capacitor range is 0.1 to 10 uF with ESR at most 400 mOhm, so 0.2 uF is inside it. (4) Ambient 0 to 50 degC is inside -40 to 125 degC. (5) Rail-down rating: the part runs from the 3.3 V rail, with EN tied to VIN (VEN >= 0.7 x VIN, 0.1 uA). So the ADXL316 and ADC_AVDD are unpowered while that rail is down. IQ is 2.6 uA max. Pins on the DBV package: 1 and 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 VIN, 5 NR (may float), 6 VREF. The ADC-side values (ENOB, rate, trigger, jitter) are the RP2354B's own and the same as for P2's reference option. Stock: JLCPCB stockCount 518, canPresaleNumber 505, extended library, 1.5757 USD at 1 and 1.3873 at 10 (vendors.py jlcpcb C6643299, 2026-09-29T03:08:16Z). The gate is 50 (5 boards x 1 placement, S4 minimum 50). Lifecycle: the TI part page https://www.ti.com/product/REF35/part-details/REF35300QDBVR shows ACTIVE (2026-09-29T03:12:44Z), and the data sheet's packaging addendum lists REF35300QDBVR as Active, Production. Digi-Key: Active, 0 in stock on every packaging, lead 9 weeks (api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/REF35300QDBVR/productdetails, 2026-09-29T03:12:12Z). Weakness, rule 5: the second vendor holds 0, and no pin-compatible alternate was found. The REF34/ADR34xx SOT-23-6 puts OUT_S on pin 5, where the REF35 has NR. Other reference families searched in this task fail. MAX6070BAUT30+T (C490943), from the same data sheet as P2's MAX6071B: JLCPCB 39, presale 38 (03:07:22Z), under 50. MCP1501-30 (DS20005474H, https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/APID/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/MCP1501-Data-Sheet-DS20005474.pdf, 03:10:03Z): maximum capacitive load 10 nF without a series resistor (5.1.2), so 0.2 uF fails. ADR3430 (Rev. C, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ADR3412_ADR3420_ADR3425_ADR3430_ADR3433_ADR3440_ADR3450.pdf, 03:03:57Z): table at VIN 3.2 to 5.5 V and IL 0; dropout 200 mV max at IL 0; load regulation and output current stated at VIN 3.5 V. MAX6063 (19-1659 Rev 1, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/MAX6061-MAX6068.pdf, 03:08:48Z): VIN min VOUT + 0.2 V, 3.206 V at 3.006 V. missed.maker: Texas Instruments (data sheet SNAS333E; JLCPCB label 'Texas Instruments'); S1 Texas Instruments
missed.why: A family P2 did not consider (ADC128S0xx multiplexed SAR), for the external ADC option. One package converts both static-angle axes, where the ADCS7476 needs 2 placements. Data sheet SNAS333E (August 2005, revised December 2015), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/adc128s052.pdf, read 2026-09-29T03:13:58Z. 12-bit SAR with 8 inputs. VA (2.7 to 5.25 V) is the reference, and the input range is 0 V to VA. With VA and the ADXL316 on the 3.3 V rail, the reading is ratiometric and covers 0 to VS. ENOB is 11.3 bits min at VA = VD = 3 V and fIN 40.2 kHz. The limits apply over TMIN to TMAX; the ADCS7476 gives 11.34. The sample rate is 200 to 500 kSPS, which is 100 to 250 kS/s on each of 2 channels, above 13,107 S/s. Trigger: a frame starts on the falling edge of CS. The input is tracked for the first 3 SCLK cycles and held for the next 13, so the coprocessor's CS and SCLK edges set each sample instant. Aperture delay is 4 ns typ; no aperture jitter is stated, as for P2's rank-3 ADS7886. Operating range is -40 to 105 degC. VD runs from 2.7 V to VA with VIH 2.1 V, so the logic is 3.3 V. DOUT goes to a bank-0 GPIO, and no RP2354B ADC input is driven. Conflict in the data sheet: Recommended Operating Conditions give 'Clock Frequency 50 to 1600 kHz', but the electrical and AC tables state fSCLK 3.2 to 8 MHz. Even at 1.6 MHz, 16 SCLK per conversion gives 100 kSPS, which is 50 kS/s per channel. P4 should resolve this. Stock: JLCPCB stockCount 2,117, canPresaleNumber 2,115, extended library, 3.4958 USD at 1, 2.9744 at 10 and 2.6641 at 30 (vendors.py jlcpcb C701598, 2026-09-29T03:14:33Z). The gate is 50 (5 boards x 1). Digi-Key: Active, 1,268 cut tape, lead 16 weeks (api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/ADC128S052CIMTX%2FNOPB/productdetails, 2026-09-29T03:14:34Z). That passes rule 5 through the second vendor. The TI part page https://www.ti.com/product/ADC128S052/part-details/ADC128S052CIMTX/NOPB shows ACTIVE (2026-09-29T03:14:34Z). The frame differs from the ADCS7476 (channel address on DIN, 4 leading zeros), so the firmware differs.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Miss 'reference output current': a shunt reference's resistor from the 3.3 V rail across about 0.2 V must carry the largest load plus the shunt's minimum current, and no maximum is stated for the ADC_AVDD draw or the ADXL316's supply current, so the resistor cannot be sized
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The requirement is 'at least 0.53 mA typical into 0.2 uF'. P2 accepts series references rated 5 mA (REF3330) against the same unstated maximum. A shunt can be sized to supply more than that. Figures from TI SNOS633N 5.11 and 5.3, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm4040-n.pdf, read 2026-09-29T03:03:58Z. A grade: +/-22 mV over -40 to 85 degC at 100 uA. IRMIN is 67 uA max. VR changes 1.1 mV max for IRMIN to 1 mA and 9 mV max for 1 to 15 mA. Recommended reverse current is 62 uA to 15 mA. The part is stable with any capacitive load. Take a 30 Ohm +/-1 % resistor from the 3.3 V rail. At 3.201 V, 30.3 Ohm and VR at most 3.0231 V, the resistor carries at least 5.87 mA. Less 0.067 mA IRMIN, that leaves 5.8 mA for the load, 11 times the 0.53 mA typical and above the REF3330's 5 mA rating. At 3.399 V, 29.7 Ohm and VR at least 2.9769 V, the shunt carries at most 14.2 mA, inside 15 mA. That is 43 mW, under the 306 mW SOT-23 rating. ADC_AVDD then spans 2.977 V to 3.032 V, inside 2.97 to 3.201 V. The shunt runs from the 3.3 V rail, so it is off with the rail down. B grade (+/-26 mV): 2.973 V to 3.036 V, 5.7 mA available, 14.35 mA max, so it also passes. Maxim LM4040AIM3-3.0+T: data sheet 19-1787 Rev 12, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/lm4040.pdf, read 03:11:37Z (safari). It gives +/-22 mV, IRMIN 67 uA, 1.0 mV and 8.0 mV current changes, a 60 uA to 15 mA range and stability with any capacitive load, so the same sizing holds. Thermal hysteresis is 0.08 % typical (2.4 mV), a typical figure, not a limit. Stock: TI A grade JLCPCB 2,969, presale 2,955 (03:07:23Z). Digi-Key: Active, 26,705 in stock, lead 9 weeks (03:12:13Z). TI B grade JLCPCB 8,663, presale 8,539 (03:07:23Z). Maxim A grade JLCPCB 8,480, presale 8,281 (03:07:23Z). P2 grouped the Diodes LM4040C30FTA (C460608) with these; its drop stands on another ground. The Diodes LM4040 data sheet (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Datasheets/LM4040.pdf, read 03:11:38Z) gives the C grade +/-34 mV over -40 to 85 degC, which is 2.966 V, under 2.97 V.
